}
.stat:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
.stat:nth-child(1)::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3b82f6, #60a5fa); }
.stat:nth-child(2)::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ef4444, #f87171); }
.stat:nth-child(3)::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f59e0b, #fbbf24); }
.stat:nth-child(4)::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #10b981, #34d399); }

.stat .icon {
  position: absolute;
  top: 16px; right: 16px;
  width: 44px; height: 44px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 20px;
  opacity: 0.7;
}
.stat:nth-child(1) .icon { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1); color: #60a5fa; }
.stat:nth-child(2) .icon { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1); color: #f87171; }
.stat:nth-child(3) .icon { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1); color: #fbbf24; }
.stat:nth-child(4) .icon { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1); color: #34d399; }

.stat .label {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text3);
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.stat .val {
  font-size: 36px;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  line-height: 1;
  transition: color 0.3s;
}
.stat .sub {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text3);
  margin-top: 8px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}
.stat .spark {
  margin-top: 12px;
  height: 32px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: end;
  gap: 2px;
}
.stat .spark .bar {
  flex: 1;
  border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0;
  min-height: 2px;
  transition: height 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

/* ============================================================================
   PANELS (glass cards)
   ============================================================================ */
.panel {
  background: var(--glass);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 20px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  transition: border-color 0.2s;
}
.panel:hover { border-color: var(--border2); }
.panel-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
}
.panel-title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 700;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.panel-title svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: var(--accent); flex-shrink: 0; }
.panel-subtitle { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text3); }

/* ============================================================================
   CHARTS
   ============================================================================ */
.charts-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
.chart-wrap { height: 220px; position: relative; }
.pie-wrap { height: 220px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

/* ============================================================================
   THREAT GAUGE (radial SVG)
   ============================================================================ */
.gauge-wrap {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 20px;
}
.gauge-svg { width: 180px; height: 120px; }
.gauge-label {
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin-top: 8px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}
.gauge-sub { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text3); margin-top: 4px; }

/* ============================================================================
   NETWORK TOPOLOGY (Canvas)
   ============================================================================ */
.topo-canvas-wrap {
  position: relative;
  height: 320px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: rgba(6, 8, 15, 0.5);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.topo-canvas-wrap canvas {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
}
.topo-legend {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 12px;
  right: 12px;
  display: flex;
  gap: 12px;
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text3);
  background: rgba(10, 14, 26, 0.8);
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}
.topo-legend .dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: inline-block;
  margin-right: 4px;
}

/* ============================================================================
   WORLD MAP
   ============================================================================ */
.map-wrap {
  position: relative;
  height: 200px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(6, 8, 15, 0.3);
}
.map-wrap svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
.map-dot {
  fill: var(--red);
  opacity: 0;
  animation: mapDotPulse 2s ease-out forwards;
}
@keyframes mapDotPulse {
  0% { opacity: 0; r: 2; }
  30% { opacity: 1; }
  100% { opacity: 0.4; r: 5; }
}

/* ============================================================================
   HEATMAP (GitHub-style)
   ============================================================================ */
.heatmap-grid {
  display: flex;
  gap: 3px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 8px 0;
}
.heatmap-cell {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: var(--surface);
  transition: background 0.3s, transform 0.15s;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.heatmap-cell:hover { transform: scale(1.5); }
.heatmap-cell.lvl-1 { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2); }
.heatmap-cell.lvl-2 { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4); }
.heatmap-cell.lvl-3 { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.5); }
.heatmap-cell.lvl-4 { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.6); }
.heatmap-cell.lvl-5 { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.85); }
.heatmap-labels {
  display: flex;
  gap: 3px;
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--text3);
  padding-top: 4px;
}

/* ============================================================================
   TOP ATTACKERS LEADERBOARD
   ============================================================================ */
.attacker-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  transition: background 0.15s;
}
.attacker-row:hover { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.04); }
.attacker-rank {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--text3);
  width: 28px;
  text-align: center;
}
.attacker-rank.top { color: var(--red); }
.attacker-ip {
  font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', monospace;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--text);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.attacker-flag { font-size: 16px; }
.attacker-bar-wrap { flex: 1; }
.attacker-bar {
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--red), var(--amber));
  transition: width 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}
.attacker-count {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text2);
  min-width: 40px;
  text-align: right;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

/* ============================================================================
   RADAR CHART
   ============================================================================ */
.radar-wrap { height: 260px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

/* ============================================================================
   CONTROLS & FORMS
   ============================================================================ */
.controls {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 14px;
  align-items: end;
}
.ctrl-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}
.ctrl-group label {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text3);
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}
.ctrl-group input,
.ctrl-group select {
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 8px 12px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-family: inherit;
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
}
.ctrl-group input:focus,
.ctrl-group select:focus {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12);
}
.ctrl-group input[type=checkbox] { width: 18px; height: 18px; accent-color: var(--accent); }

/* Buttons */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 9px 18px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--text);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: inherit;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}
.btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent); background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.06); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.btn-primary { background: var(--accent-g); border-color: transparent; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25); }
.btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.35); }
.btn-danger { border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25); color: #f87171; }
.btn-danger:hover { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08); border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4); }

/* Attack Sim Buttons */
.sim-btn {
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2);
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.06);
  color: #f87171;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: inherit;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}
.sim-btn:hover {
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12);
  border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
}

/* Toast / Save Message */
.toast { font-size: 12px; color: var(--green); min-height: 18px; margin-top: 8px; }

/* ============================================================================
   CHIPS
   ============================================================================ */
.chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.chip {
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border-radius: 99px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  transition: all 0.15s;
}
.chip:hover { border-color: rgba(99, 130, 190, 0.25); background: var(--surface2); }

/* ============================================================================
   EVENT TABLE
   ============================================================================ */
.tbl-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto;
  border-radius: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  max-height: 420px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  transition: max-height 0.3s ease;
}
.tbl-wrap.expanded { max-height: none; }

.expand-btn {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 10px;
  margin-top: 8px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--text2);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: inherit;
  transition: all 0.15s;
}
.expand-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--text); background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.04); }

table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; }
thead { background: var(--surface2); }
th {
  padding: 11px 14px;
  text-align: left;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text3);
  font-size: 11px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  white-space: nowrap;
  border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border);
}
td {
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(99, 130, 190, 0.06);
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
tbody tr { transition: background 0.12s; cursor: pointer; }
tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.05); }
tbody tr.selected { background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1); }

/* Tags */
.tag {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 99px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}
.t-ok { background: var(--green-soft); color: #34d399; }
.t-warn { background: var(--amber-soft); color: #fbbf24; }
.t-bad { background: var(--red-soft); color: #f87171; }
.t-info { background: var(--cyan-soft); color: #22d3ee; }

/* Score cell with progress bar */
.score-cell { position: relative; font-weight: 700; }
.score-bar { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; border-radius: 4px; opacity: 0.1; z-index: 0; }
.score-val { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

.reason { font-size: 12px; color: #a78bfa; max-width: 340px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.threat-cell { font-size: 12px; }

/* ============================================================================
   FILTERS
   ============================================================================ */
.filters { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.filters label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text3); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.filters select,
.filters input[type=text] {
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--text);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-family: inherit;
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.15s;
}
.filters select:focus,
.filters input[type=text]:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
.filters input[type=checkbox] { accent-color: var(--accent); }

/* ============================================================================
   SHAP DETAIL MODAL
   ============================================================================ */
.modal-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  z-index: 1000;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.25s;
}
.modal-overlay.active { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
.modal {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--border2);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 28px;
  max-width: 600px;
  width: 90%;
  max-height: 80vh;
  overflow-y: auto;
  transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.96);
  transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
}
.modal-overlay.active .modal { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
.modal-close {
  position: absolute;
  top: 16px;
  right: 16px;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  color: var(--text3);
  font-size: 20px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: color 0.15s;
}
.modal-close:hover { color: var(--text); }
.modal h3 { font-size: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; }

/* SHAP Bars */
.shap-bar-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 6px 0;
}
.shap-feature {
  width: 130px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--text2);
  text-align: right;
  font-weight: 500;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.shap-bar-wrap { flex: 1; height: 18px; position: relative; }
.shap-bar {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 4px;
  transition: width 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
}
.shap-bar.positive { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3), rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.7)); left: 50%; }
.shap-bar.negative { background: linear-gradient(270deg, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.3), rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.7)); right: 50%; }
.shap-val {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  min-width: 50px;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
.shap-val.pos { color: var(--red); }
.shap-val.neg { color: var(--accent); }

/* ============================================================================
   NOTIFICATION TOASTS (Unobtrusive Bottom-Right)
   ============================================================================ */
.toast-container {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 24px;
  right: 24px;
  z-index: 2000;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column-reverse;
  gap: 8px;
  pointer-events: none;
  max-width: 340px;
}
.toast-item {
  pointer-events: auto;
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95);
  border: 1px solid var(--border2);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 10px 14px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 500;
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
  transform: translateX(120%);
  animation: toastSlideIn 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) forwards;
}
.toast-item.exit { animation: toastSlideOut 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) forwards; }
.toast-item.attack { border-left: 3px solid var(--red); }
.toast-item.block { border-left: 3px solid var(--amber); }
.toast-item.info, .toast-item.ok { border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); }
.toast-item.bad, .toast-item.error { border-left: 3px solid var(--red); }
.toast-item .toast-icon { font-size: 16px; }
.toast-item .toast-msg { flex: 1; word-break: break-word; }

@keyframes toastSlideIn {
  from { transform: translateX(120%); opacity: 0; }
  to { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; }
}
@keyframes toastSlideOut {
  from { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; }
  to { transform: translateX(120%); opacity: 0; }
}

/* ============================================================================
   FOOTER
   ============================================================================ */
.footer {
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--text3);
  font-size: 12px;
  margin-top: 40px;
  padding: 24px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
}

/* ============================================================================
   ANIMATIONS
   ============================================================================ */
@keyframes pulse-dot {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0.3; }
}
@keyframes fadeInUp {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
.fade-in { animation: fadeInUp 0.45s ease-out; }

/* Staggered card entrance */
.stat:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0s; }
.stat:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.07s; }
.stat:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.14s; }
.stat:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.21s; }
.stat { animation: fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out both; }

/* Panel entrance animations with stagger */
.panel { animation: fadeInUp 0.5s ease-out both; }
.panel:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.05s; }
.panel:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.12s; }
.panel:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.19s; }
.panel:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.26s; }

/* Rolling number animation */
@keyframes countPop {
  0% { transform: scale(1); }
  50% { transform: scale(1.12); }
  100% { transform: scale(1); }
}
.count-pop { animation: countPop 0.3s ease-out; }

/* ============================================================================
   BUTTON ACTIVE / PRESSED STATES
   ============================================================================ */
.btn:active {
  transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.97);
  box-shadow: none;
  transition-duration: 0.05s;
}
.btn-primary:active {
  opacity: 0.8;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15);
}
.btn-danger:active {
  background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
}
.sim-btn:active {
  transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.97);
  box-shadow: none;
}
.expand-btn:active {
  transform: scale(0.98);
  background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.08);
}

/* ============================================================================
   FOCUS ACCESSIBILITY
   ============================================================================ */
.btn:focus-visible,
.sim-btn:focus-visible,
.expand-btn:focus-visible,
.nav-item:focus-visible,
.ctrl-group input:focus-visible,
.ctrl-group select:focus-visible,
.filters select:focus-visible,
.filters input:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* ============================================================================
   MODEL INFO ROW
   ============================================================================ */
.model-info { display: flex; gap: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.model-info .mi { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; min-width: 100px; }
.model-info .mi-label { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text3); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
.model-info .mi-val { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

/* ============================================================================
   GRID HELPERS
   ============================================================================ */
.grid-2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
.grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
.grid-2-1 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }
.grid-1-1-1 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }

/* ============================================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ============================================================================ */
@media (max-width: 1200px) {
  .stats { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .charts-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .grid-2, .grid-2-1 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .grid-3, .grid-1-1-1 { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .stats { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .stat .val { font-size: 30px; }
  .grid-3, .grid-1-1-1 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .content { padding: 20px; }
  .sidebar { width: 220px; }
  .main-content { margin-left: 220px; }
  .topo-canvas-wrap { height: 260px; }
  table { font-size: 12px; }
  th, td { padding: 8px 10px; }
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .sidebar { transform: translateX(-100%); width: var(--sidebar-w); }
  .sidebar.open { transform: translateX(0); }
  .main-content { margin-left: 0; }
  .menu-toggle { display: flex; }
  .content { padding: 16px; }
  .stats { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .stat .val { font-size: 28px; }
  .controls { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
  .grid-3, .grid-1-1-1 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .charts-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .filters { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
  .panel-header { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .content { padding: 12px; }
  .topbar { padding: 0 12px; }
  .stat { padding: 14px; }
  .stat .val { font-size: 24px; }
  .panel { padding: 14px; }

            Recent Events
          </div>
          <div class="filters">
            <label>State <select id="flt_state"><option value="all">All</option><option value="ATTACK">Attack</option><option value="benign">Benign</option></select></label>
            <label><input id="flt_blocked" type="checkbox"/> Blocked only</label>
            <label>Search <input id="flt_text" type="text" placeholder="type / reason / IP..." style="min-width:180px"/></label>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="tbl-wrap" id="tbl_wrap">
          <table>
            <thead><tr><th>Timestamp</th><th>#</th><th>Score</th><th>State</th><th>Threat Intel</th><th>XAI Reason</th><th>Classification</th><th>Hits</th><th>Action</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody id="rows"></tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
        <button class="expand-btn" id="btn_expand" onclick="toggleExpand()">▼ Show All Events</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ==================== PAGE: SIMULATE ==================== -->
    <div class="page" id="page_simulate" style="display:none">
      <div class="section-title">Attack Simulation Lab</div>
      <div class="panel fade-in" style="border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.15)">
        <div class="panel-header">
          <div class="panel-title" style="color:#f87171">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#f87171" stroke-width="2"><polygon points="13 2 3 14 12 14 11 22 21 10 12 10 13 2"/></svg>
            Launch Simulated Attacks
          </div>
          <div class="panel-subtitle">Injects attack-pattern features → decision loop scores → dashboard updates</div>
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:8px">
          <button class="sim-btn" onclick="launchAttack('syn')">⚡ SYN Flood</button>
          <button class="sim-btn" onclick="launchAttack('udp')">🌊 UDP Flood</button>
          <button class="sim-btn" onclick="launchAttack('http')">🐌 HTTP Slowloris</button>
          <button class="sim-btn" onclick="launchAttack('scan')">🔍 Port Scan</button>
          <button class="sim-btn" onclick="launchAttack('botnet')">🤖 IoT Botnet</button>
          <button class="sim-btn" onclick="launchAttack('exfil')">📤 Data Exfil</button>
        </div>
        <div id="sim_msg" style="color:var(--amber);margin-top:12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;min-height:20px"></div>
      </div>

      <div class="section-title" style="margin-top:24px">How It Works</div>
      <div class="panel fade-in">
        <div style="font-size:13px;color:var(--text2);line-height:1.8">
          <p>Each button injects <strong>realistic attack-pattern feature rows</strong> directly into <code style="color:var(--accent);background:rgba(59,130,246,0.1);padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px">data/features.csv</code>.</p>
          <p style="margin-top:8px">The <strong>decision loop</strong> picks up the rows, scores them with the ML model, and writes detections to <code style="color:var(--accent);background:rgba(59,130,246,0.1);padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px">alerts.jsonl</code>.</p>
          <p style="margin-top:8px">The dashboard then visualizes everything in real-time. No Scapy or admin privileges required.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </div><!-- /content -->

  <div class="footer">IoTGuard IDS v2.0 · ML-Driven Intrusion Detection · LightGBM + SHAP + Ensemble · <span id="footer_clock"></span></div>
</div><!-- /main-content -->

</div><!-- /app-layout -->

<script>
// ============================================================================
// IoTGuard Dashboard — JavaScript Engine
// ============================================================================
'use strict';

// --- STATE ---
let lastTs = null, chart, pieChart, radarChart;
let chartData = {labels:[], scores:[], thresholds:[]};
let lastBlockTs = 0, allEvents = [], fltState = 'all', fltBlockedOnly = false, fltText = '';
let sparkHistory = {total:[], attacks:[], blocks:[]};
let topoAnimFrame = null, topoData = null;
const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();

// --- PAGE NAVIGATION ---
function switchPage(page) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(p => p.style.display = 'none');
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(n => n.classList.remove('active'));
  const el = document.getElementById('page_' + page);
  if (el) el.style.display = 'block';
  const nav = document.querySelector(`.nav-item[data-page="${page}"]`);
  if (nav) nav.classList.add('active');
  const titles = {dashboard:'Dashboard',network:'Network Map',analytics:'Analytics',controls:'Settings',events:'Event Log',simulate:'Attack Lab'};
  document.getElementById('page_title').textContent = titles[page] || 'Dashboard';
  // Initialize page-specific content
  if (page === 'network') initTopology();
  if (page === 'analytics') { loadRadar(); loadHeatmap(); }
}

// --- AUDIO ---
function beep(){const o=audioCtx.createOscillator(),g=audioCtx.createGain();o.connect(g);g.connect(audioCtx.destination);o.type='square';o.frequency.value=880;g.gain.value=0.04;o.start();setTimeout(()=>o.stop(),140)}

// --- UTILS ---
function iso(ts){try{return new Date(ts*1000).toLocaleString('en-GB',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',second:'2-digit'})}catch{return'-'}}
function tag(t,c){return'<span class="tag '+c+'">'+t+'</span>'}
function stateTag(s){return s==='ATTACK'?tag('ATTACK','t-bad'):tag('BENIGN','t-ok')}
function actionTag(a){
  if(!a||!a.startsWith('BLOCK'))return tag('NONE','t-ok');
  if(a==='BLOCK-KILL')return tag('BLOCK KILL','t-bad');
  if(a==='BLOCK-HARD')return tag('BLOCK HARD','t-warn');
  return tag(a.replace('-',' '),'t-warn');
}
function scoreCell(s){
  const v=(s??0).toFixed(3);
  const c=s>=0.9?'var(--red)':s>=0.7?'var(--amber)':'var(--green)';
  const bg=s>=0.9?'rgba(239,68,68,':s>=0.7?'rgba(245,158,11,':'rgba(16,185,129,';
  const w=Math.round(s*100);
  return'<td class="score-cell"><div class="score-bar" style="width:'+w+'%;background:'+bg+'.15)"></div><span class="score-val" style="color:'+c+'">'+v+'</span></td>';
}
function reasonHtml(r){return r?'<span class="reason" title="'+r.replace(/"/g,'&quot;')+'">'+r+'</span>':'<span style="color:var(--text3)">-</span>'}
function threatHtml(t){
  if(!t)return'<span style="color:var(--text3)">-</span>';
  let h='';
  if(t.flag)h+=`<span style="font-size:14px;margin-right:4px">${t.flag}</span>`;
  if(t.country)h+=`<span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text2);margin-right:6px">${t.country}</span>`;
  if(t.threat)h+=tag(t.threat,'t-bad');
  return h||'<span style="color:var(--text3)">-</span>';
}

// --- NOTIFICATION TOASTS (Unobtrusive Bottom-Right) ---
function showToast(type, msg) {
  const c = document.getElementById('toast_container');
  if (!c) return;
  const el = document.createElement('div');
  el.className = 'toast-item ' + type;
  const icons = {attack:'🚨',block:'🛑',info:'ℹ️',bad:'❌',ok:'✅',error:'❌'};
  el.innerHTML = `<span class="toast-icon">${icons[type]||'ℹ️'}</span><span class="toast-msg">${msg}</span><button onclick="this.parentElement.remove()" style="background:none;border:none;color:var(--text3);cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;line-height:1;padding:0 0 0 8px;margin-left:auto">&times;</button>`;
  c.appendChild(el);
  setTimeout(()=>{
    el.classList.add('exit');
    setTimeout(()=>el.remove(), 250);
  }, 3000);
  // Keep max 3 toasts
  while(c.children.length > 3) c.children[0].remove();
}

// --- ANIMATED NUMBER UPDATE ---
function animateValue(el, newVal) {
  const old = parseInt(el.textContent) || 0;
  if (old === newVal) return;
  el.textContent = newVal;
  el.classList.remove('count-pop');
  void el.offsetWidth; // force reflow
  el.classList.add('count-pop');
}

// --- SPARKLINES ---
function updateSpark(id, history, color) {
  const el = document.getElementById(id);
  if (!el) return;
  const max = Math.max(...history, 1);
  el.innerHTML = history.slice(-20).map(v =>
    `<div class="bar" style="height:${Math.max(2, (v/max)*100)}%;background:${color}"></div>`
  ).join('');
}

// --- THREAT GAUGE ---
function updateGauge(score) {
  const arc = document.getElementById('gauge_arc');
  const needle = document.getElementById('gauge_needle');
  const label = document.getElementById('gauge_text');
  const sub = document.getElementById('gauge_sub');
  if (!arc) return;
  const pct = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, score));
  const arcLen = 251; // approximate arc length
  arc.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', `${pct * arcLen} ${arcLen}`);
  // Needle rotation: -90 to +90 degrees mapped to 0-1
  const angle = -90 + pct * 180;
  needle.style.transform = `rotate(${angle}deg)`;
  if (pct < 0.3) { label.textContent = 'LOW'; label.style.color = 'var(--green)'; arc.setAttribute('stroke', 'url(#gg_low)'); sub.textContent = 'System operating normally'; }
  else if (pct < 0.6) { label.textContent = 'MEDIUM'; label.style.color = 'var(--amber)'; arc.setAttribute('stroke', 'url(#gg_med)'); sub.textContent = 'Elevated threat activity detected'; }
  else if (pct < 0.85) { label.textContent = 'HIGH'; label.style.color = '#f87171'; arc.setAttribute('stroke', 'url(#gg_high)'); sub.textContent = 'Active attacks in progress'; }
  else { label.textContent = 'CRITICAL'; label.style.color = '#ef4444'; arc.setAttribute('stroke', 'url(#gg_high)'); sub.textContent = '⚠ Multiple active threats — take action!'; }
}

// --- TABLE & TAXONOMY BADGES ---
function catBadge(cat, sev) {
  if (!cat || cat === 'Benign' || cat === 'benign') return '<span class="tag t-good">Benign</span>';
  const s = String(sev || 'HIGH').toUpperCase();
  const colors = {
    'CRITICAL': 'background:rgba(239,68,68,0.22);color:#fca5a5;border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.45)',
    'HIGH': 'background:rgba(249,115,22,0.22);color:#fdba74;border:1px solid rgba(249,115,22,0.45)',
    'MEDIUM': 'background:rgba(245,158,11,0.22);color:#fde68a;border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,0.45)',
    'LOW': 'background:rgba(59,130,246,0.22);color:#93c5fd;border:1px solid rgba(59,130,246,0.45)',
  };
  const style = colors[s] || colors['HIGH'];
  return `<span style="padding:2px 8px;border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;${style}"><span>⚡</span>${cat}</span>`;
}

function rowHtml(e) {
  const isAtk = e.state === 'ATTACK';
  const cat = e.attack_category || (isAtk ? (e.pred_class || 'DDoS-SYN') : 'Benign');
  const pb = e.remediation_playbook;
  const sev = pb ? pb.severity : (isAtk ? 'HIGH' : 'LOW');
  
  const classificationHtml = isAtk
    ? `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px">
         ${catBadge(cat, sev)}
         <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();openShapModal(${e.index})" title="View Remediation Playbook" style="background:rgba(99,130,190,0.18);border:1px solid rgba(99,130,190,0.35);color:#cbd5e1;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:10px;font-weight:600">📋 Playbook</button>
       </div>`
    : '<span class="tag t-good">Benign</span>';

  return `<tr onclick="openShapModal(${e.index})" title="Click for Remediation Playbook & SHAP detail" style="cursor:pointer">
    <td>${iso(e.ts)}</td><td>${e.index}</td>${scoreCell(e.score??0)}<td>${stateTag(e.state)}</td>
    <td class="threat-cell">${threatHtml(e.threat)}</td><td>${reasonHtml(e.reason)}</td>
    <td>${classificationHtml}</td><td>${e.hits_in_window??0}</td><td>${actionTag(e.action)}</td></tr>`;
}
function passesFilters(e){
  if(fltState!=='all'&&e.state!==fltState)return false;
  if(fltBlockedOnly&&!(e.action&&String(e.action).startsWith('BLOCK')))return false;
  if(fltText){const t=fltText;const hay=[e.attack_category||'',e.pred_class||'',e.reason||'',(e.threat&&(e.threat.threat||e.threat.country||''))||''].join(' ').toLowerCase();if(!hay.includes(t))return false}
  return true;
}
function renderTable(){
  const tbody=document.getElementById('rows');if(!tbody)return;
  let html='';const src=allEvents.slice(-200).reverse();
  for(const e of src){if(!passesFilters(e))continue;html+=rowHtml(e)}
  tbody.innerHTML=html;
}
function toggleExpand(){const w=document.getElementById('tbl_wrap'),b=document.getElementById('btn_expand');w.classList.toggle('expanded');b.textContent=w.classList.contains('expanded')?'▲ Collapse Events':'▼ Show All Events'}

// --- REMEDIATION PLAYBOOK & SHAP MODAL ---
async function openShapModal(index) {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('shap_modal');
  const ev = allEvents.find(e => e.index === index) || {};
  const isAtk = ev.state === 'ATTACK';
  const pbCard = document.getElementById('playbook_card');
  const catBadgeEl = document.getElementById('modal_cat_badge');

  const pb = ev.remediation_playbook;
  const cat = ev.attack_category || ev.pred_class || (isAtk ? 'Attack Anomaly' : 'Benign');

  if (isAtk && (pb || cat)) {
    pbCard.style.display = 'block';
    catBadgeEl.style.display = 'inline-block';
    catBadgeEl.innerHTML = catBadge(cat, pb ? pb.severity : 'HIGH');

    document.getElementById('pb_title').textContent = pb && pb.title ? pb.title : `${cat} Remediation Playbook`;
    const sevEl = document.getElementById('pb_severity');
    const sevText = pb && pb.severity ? pb.severity : 'HIGH';
    sevEl.textContent = sevText;
    sevEl.className = 'tag ' + (sevText === 'CRITICAL' || sevText === 'HIGH' ? 't-bad' : 't-warn');

    document.getElementById('pb_action').textContent = pb && pb.recommended_action ? pb.recommended_action : 'Quarantine source IP and inspect anomalous flow indicators.';
    document.getElementById('pb_ports').textContent = pb && pb.port_restrictions ? pb.port_restrictions : 'Inspect affected TCP/UDP transport ports.';
    document.getElementById('pb_ratelimit').textContent = pb && pb.rate_limit_policy ? pb.rate_limit_policy : 'Apply adaptive throttling per host.';
    document.getElementById('pb_rule').textContent = pb && pb.firewall_rule ? pb.firewall_rule : `netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="IoTGuard_Block" dir=in action=block remoteip=${ev.src_ip || '<TARGET_IP>'}`;
    document.getElementById('pb_hint').textContent = pb && pb.payload_inspection_hint ? pb.payload_inspection_hint : 'Analyze packet inter-arrival times and protocol ratios.';
  } else {
    pbCard.style.display = 'none';
    catBadgeEl.style.display = 'none';
  }

  try {
    const r = await fetch('/api/shap_detail?index=' + index);
    const j = await r.json();
    if (!j.ok) {
      if (!isAtk) showToast('info', 'No SHAP data for event #' + index);
    }
    document.getElementById('shap_title').textContent = isAtk ? `🛡️ ${cat} — Event #${index}` : `🔍 SHAP — Event #${index}`;
    const scoreVal = j.score ?? ev.score ?? 0;
    const scoreColor = scoreVal >= 0.7 ? 'var(--red)' : 'var(--green)';
    document.getElementById('shap_meta').innerHTML = `Score: <strong style="color:${scoreColor}"> ${scoreVal.toFixed(4)}</strong> · State: ${stateTag(ev.state || j.state)} · Taxonomy: <strong>${cat}</strong>${ev.src_ip ? ' · Target IP: <code>' + ev.src_ip + '</code>' : ''}`;

    const bars = document.getElementById('shap_bars');
    const contribs = j.contributions || [];
    if (!contribs.length) {
      bars.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--text3);text-align:center;padding:14px;font-size:12px">No SHAP contributions available for this event</div>';
    } else {
      const maxAbs = Math.max(...contribs.map(c => Math.abs(c.value)), 0.01);
      bars.innerHTML = contribs.map(c => {
        const pct = Math.abs(c.value) / maxAbs * 45;
        const isPos = c.value > 0;
        return `<div class="shap-bar-row">
          <div class="shap-feature">${c.feature}</div>
          <div class="shap-bar-wrap"><div class="shap-bar ${isPos?'positive':'negative'}" style="width:${pct}%"></div></div>
          <div class="shap-val ${isPos?'pos':'neg'}">${isPos?'+':''}${c.value.toFixed(3)}</div>
        </div>`;
      }).join('');
    }
    overlay.classList.add('active');
  } catch(e) {
    overlay.classList.add('active');
  }
}
function closeShapModal() { document.getElementById('shap_modal').classList.remove('active'); }
document.getElementById('shap_modal').addEventListener('click', e => { if(e.target.classList.contains('modal-overlay')) closeShapModal(); });

function copyFirewallRule() {
  const code = document.getElementById('pb_rule').textContent;
  if (code && navigator.clipboard) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code);
    showToast('info', '📋 Firewall rule copied to clipboard');
  }
}

// --- CHARTS SETUP ---
function setupCharts() {
  const ctx = document.getElementById('scoreChart').getContext('2d');
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,220);
  grad.addColorStop(0,'rgba(59,130,246,.3)');grad.addColorStop(1,'rgba(59,130,246,.0)');
  chart = new Chart(ctx,{type:'line',data:{labels:[],datasets:[
    {label:'Score',data:[],borderWidth:2,pointRadius:0,borderColor:'#3b82f6',backgroundColor:grad,fill:true,tension:.35},
    {label:'Threshold',data:[],borderWidth:2,pointRadius:0,borderColor:'#f59e0b',borderDash:[6,4],fill:false}
  ]},options:{animation:false,responsive:true,maintainAspectRatio:false,
    interaction:{intersect:false,mode:'index'},
    scales:{x:{display:false},y:{min:0,max:1,grid:{color:'rgba(99,130,190,.06)'},ticks:{color:'#64748b',font:{size:11}}}},
    plugins:{legend:{display:false},tooltip:{backgroundColor:'rgba(12,20,37,.95)',borderColor:'rgba(99,130,190,.2)',borderWidth:1,titleColor:'#e2e8f0',bodyColor:'#94a3b8',padding:10,cornerRadius:8}}
  }});
  const colors = ['#3b82f6','#8b5cf6','#ef4444','#f59e0b','#10b981','#06b6d4','#ec4899','#6366f1'];
  pieChart = new Chart(document.getElementById('pieChart'),{type:'doughnut',data:{labels:[],datasets:[{data:[],backgroundColor:colors,borderWidth:0,hoverOffset:6}]},
    options:{responsive:true,maintainAspectRatio:false,cutout:'65%',plugins:{legend:{position:'right',labels:{color:'#94a3b8',padding:12,font:{size:11},usePointStyle:true,pointStyle:'circle'}},tooltip:{backgroundColor:'rgba(12,20,37,.95)',borderColor:'rgba(99,130,190,.2)',borderWidth:1,titleColor:'#e2e8f0',bodyColor:'#94a3b8',padding:10,cornerRadius:8}}}
  });
}

// --- RADAR CHART ---
async function loadRadar() {
  try {
    const r = await fetch('/api/feature_radar');
    const j = await r.json();
    if (!j.ok) return;
    const ctx = document.getElementById('radarChart');
    if (radarChart) radarChart.destroy();
    radarChart = new Chart(ctx, {type:'radar',data:{labels:j.features.map(f=>f.replace('_',' ')),datasets:[{
      label:'Feature Values',data:j.values,borderColor:'#3b82f6',backgroundColor:'rgba(59,130,246,.15)',borderWidth:2,pointBackgroundColor:'#3b82f6',pointRadius:3
    }]},options:{responsive:true,maintainAspectRatio:false,scales:{r:{beginAtZero:true,max:1,grid:{color:'rgba(99,130,190,.08)'},pointLabels:{color:'#94a3b8',font:{size:10}},ticks:{display:false}}},
      plugins:{legend:{display:false},tooltip:{backgroundColor:'rgba(12,20,37,.95)',borderColor:'rgba(99,130,190,.2)',borderWidth:1,titleColor:'#e2e8f0',bodyColor:'#94a3b8',cornerRadius:8}}}
    });
  } catch(e) { console.log('Radar load failed:', e); }
}

// --- HEATMAP ---
async function loadHeatmap() {
  try {
    const r = await fetch('/api/timeline_heatmap?days=7');
    const j = await r.json();
    if (!j.ok) return;
    const c = document.getElementById('heatmap_container');
    const maxVal = Math.max(...j.days.flatMap(d => d.hours), 1);
    let html = '<div style="display:flex;gap:4px;flex-direction:column">';
    for (const day of j.days) {
      html += `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px"><span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text3);width:30px;text-align:right">${day.label}</span>`;
      for (let h = 0; h < 24; h++) {
        const v = day.hours[h] || 0;
        const lvl = v === 0 ? 0 : v <= maxVal*0.2 ? 1 : v <= maxVal*0.4 ? 2 : v <= maxVal*0.6 ? 3 : v <= maxVal*0.8 ? 4 : 5;
        html += `<div class="heatmap-cell lvl-${lvl}" title="${day.date} ${h}:00 — ${v} attacks"></div>`;
      }
      html += '</div>';
    }
    html += '</div>';
    html += '<div class="heatmap-labels" style="margin-left:34px">';
    for (let h = 0; h < 24; h += 3) html += `<span style="width:${3*17}px">${h}:00</span>`;
    html += '</div>';
    c.innerHTML = html;
  } catch(e) { console.log('Heatmap load failed:', e); }
}

// --- INTERACTIVE TOPOLOGY & DEVICE TELEMETRY ---
let topoFilter = 'all';
let currentSelectedDevice = null;
let hoveredDevice = null;
let topoListenersAttached = false;

function setTopoFilter(filter) {
  topoFilter = filter;
  ['all', 'iot', 'it', 'threats'].forEach(f => {
    const el = document.getElementById(`topo_filter_${f}`);
    if (el) {
      if (f === filter) {
        el.style.background = 'var(--primary)';
        el.style.color = '#fff';
        el.style.fontWeight = '700';
      } else {
        el.style.background = 'transparent';
        el.style.color = 'var(--text2)';
        el.style.fontWeight = '500';
      }
    }
  });
}

function openDeviceModal(dev) {
  if (!dev) return;
  currentSelectedDevice = dev;
  const ip = dev.ip || dev.id;
  const isBlocked = dev.state === 'BLOCKED' || dev.blocked;
  const isGrace = dev.state === 'GRACE';

  const nameEl = document.getElementById('dev_name');
  const ipEl = document.getElementById('dev_ip');
  const badgeEl = document.getElementById('dev_state_badge');
  const typeEl = document.getElementById('dev_classification');
  const geoEl = document.getElementById('dev_geo');
  const ispEl = document.getElementById('dev_isp');
  const threatEl = document.getElementById('dev_threat');
  const btnQuarantine = document.getElementById('btn_dev_quarantine');
  const btnUnblock = document.getElementById('btn_dev_unblock');

  if (nameEl) nameEl.textContent = dev.label || `Device ${ip}`;
  if (ipEl) ipEl.textContent = `IP: ${ip} · Entity: ${dev.id}`;
  
  if (badgeEl) {
    if (isBlocked) {
      badgeEl.className = 'tag t-bad';
      badgeEl.textContent = 'QUARANTINED (BLOCKED)';
    } else if (isGrace) {
      badgeEl.className = 'tag t-warn';
      badgeEl.textContent = 'GRACE PERIOD (WARNING)';
    } else {
      badgeEl.className = 'tag t-ok';
      badgeEl.textContent = 'BENIGN (HEALTHY)';
    }
  }

  if (typeEl) {
    const isIoT = dev.type === 'iot' || dev.type === 'router' || dev.type === 'firewall';
    typeEl.textContent = `${isIoT ? '📡 IoT Device' : '💻 IT Endpoint'} (${(dev.type || 'unknown').toUpperCase()})`;
    typeEl.style.color = isIoT ? '#10b981' : '#06b6d4';
  }

  if (geoEl) {
    const flag = dev.flag || '🏠';
    const cName = dev.country_name || (dev.country === 'LAN' ? 'Private Network' : dev.country || 'Unknown');
    geoEl.textContent = `${flag} ${cName}`;
  }

  if (ispEl) {
    ispEl.textContent = dev.isp || (dev.country === 'LAN' ? 'Internal Gateway / Subnet' : 'Autonomous Network');
  }

  if (threatEl) {
    if (dev.threat) {
      threatEl.textContent = `🚨 ${dev.threat}`;
      threatEl.style.color = '#ef4444';
    } else if (dev.abuse_score && dev.abuse_score > 0) {
      threatEl.textContent = `⚠️ Abuse Confidence: ${dev.abuse_score}%`;
      threatEl.style.color = '#f59e0b';
    } else {
      threatEl.textContent = '✅ Clean / Normal Profile';
      threatEl.style.color = '#10b981';
    }
  }

  if (btnQuarantine && btnUnblock) {
    if (isBlocked) {
      btnQuarantine.style.opacity = '0.5';
      btnQuarantine.disabled = true;
      btnUnblock.style.opacity = '1.0';
      btnUnblock.disabled = false;
    } else {
      btnQuarantine.style.opacity = '1.0';
      btnQuarantine.disabled = false;
      btnUnblock.style.opacity = '0.5';
      btnUnblock.disabled = true;
    }
  }

  const modal = document.getElementById('device_modal');
  if (modal) modal.classList.add('open');
}

function closeDeviceModal() {
  const modal = document.getElementById('device_modal');
  if (modal) modal.classList.remove('open');
  currentSelectedDevice = null;
}

async function quarantineCurrentDevice() {
  if (!currentSelectedDevice || !currentSelectedDevice.ip) return;
  const ip = currentSelectedDevice.ip;
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/block', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({ip: ip, severity: 'hard', reason: 'Operator Manual Quarantine'}),
    });
    const j = await res.json();
    if (j.ok) {
      showToast(`🚫 Quarantine rule applied for ${ip}`, 'bad');
      closeDeviceModal();
      await loadTopology();
    } else {
      showToast(`Failed to quarantine: ${j.error || 'Unknown error'}`, 'bad');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    showToast(`Block error: ${err}`, 'bad');
  }
}

async function unblockCurrentDevice() {
  if (!currentSelectedDevice || !currentSelectedDevice.ip) return;
  const ip = currentSelectedDevice.ip;
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/unblock', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
      body: JSON.stringify({ip: ip}),
    });
    const j = await res.json();
    if (j.ok) {
      showToast(`✅ Host ${ip} unblocked and restored`, 'ok');
      closeDeviceModal();
      await loadTopology();
    } else {
      showToast(`Failed to unblock: ${j.error || 'Unknown error'}`, 'bad');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    showToast(`Unblock error: ${err}`, 'bad');
  }
}

function initTopology() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('topoCanvas');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const wrap = canvas.parentElement;
  canvas.width = wrap.clientWidth * 2;
  canvas.height = wrap.clientHeight * 2;
  canvas.style.width = wrap.clientWidth + 'px';
  canvas.style.height = wrap.clientHeight + 'px';

  if (!topoListenersAttached) {
    topoListenersAttached = true;
    canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      if (!topoData || !topoData.devices) return;
      const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
      const mx = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * W;
      const my = ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * H;

      let hit = null;
      for (const d of topoData.devices) {
        if (!shouldRenderDevice(d)) continue;
        const dx = d.x * W, dy = d.y * H;
        const dist = Math.hypot(mx - dx, my - dy);
        if (dist <= 30) {
          hit = d;
          break;
        }
      }
      hoveredDevice = hit;
      canvas.style.cursor = hit ? 'pointer' : 'default';
    });

    canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (hoveredDevice) {
        openDeviceModal(hoveredDevice);
      }
    });
  }

  loadTopology();
}

function shouldRenderDevice(d) {
  if (topoFilter === 'all') return true;
  if (topoFilter === 'iot') return d.type === 'iot' || d.type === 'router' || d.type === 'firewall';
  if (topoFilter === 'it') return d.type === 'it' || d.type === 'router' || d.type === 'firewall';
  if (topoFilter === 'threats') return d.state === 'BLOCKED' || d.state === 'GRACE' || Boolean(d.threat);
  return true;
}

let topoParticles = [];
async function loadTopology() {
  try {
    const r = await fetch('/api/topology');
    topoData = await r.json();
    if (topoData.ok) {
      topoParticles = [];
      updateTopologySummary(topoData.summary);
      drawTopology();
    }
  } catch(e) { console.log('Topology load failed:', e); }
}

function updateTopologySummary(sum) {
  if (!sum) return;
  const setTxt = (id, val) => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.textContent = val !== undefined ? val : 0;
  };
  setTxt('topo_count_total', sum.total_nodes);
  setTxt('topo_count_iot', sum.iot_count);
  setTxt('topo_count_it', sum.it_count);
  setTxt('topo_count_grace', sum.grace_count);
  setTxt('topo_count_blocked', sum.blocked_count);
}

function drawTopology() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('topoCanvas');
  if (!canvas || !topoData) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  const deviceMap = {};
  topoData.devices.forEach(d => { deviceMap[d.id] = d; });

  // Draw connections
  for (const conn of topoData.connections) {
    const from = deviceMap[conn.from], to = deviceMap[conn.to];
    if (!from || !to) continue;
    if (!shouldRenderDevice(from) || !shouldRenderDevice(to)) continue;

    const fx = from.x * W, fy = from.y * H, tx = to.x * W, ty = to.y * H;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(fx, fy); ctx.lineTo(tx, ty);

    const isAttacked = conn.attack || to.state === 'BLOCKED' || to.state === 'GRACE';
    ctx.strokeStyle = to.state === 'BLOCKED' ? 'rgba(239,68,68,0.6)' : isAttacked ? 'rgba(245,158,11,0.5)' : 'rgba(99,130,190,0.12)';
    ctx.lineWidth = isAttacked ? 3 : 1.5;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Add glowing particle on active connection
    if (isAttacked && Math.random() < 0.20) {
      const pColor = to.state === 'BLOCKED' ? 'rgba(239,68,68,' : 'rgba(245,158,11,';
      topoParticles.push({fx, fy, tx, ty, progress: 0, speed: 0.009 + Math.random() * 0.012, color: pColor});
    }
  }

  // Draw dynamic particles
  topoParticles = topoParticles.filter(p => p.progress < 1);
  for (const p of topoParticles) {
    p.progress += p.speed;
    const x = p.fx + (p.tx - p.fx) * p.progress;
    const y = p.fy + (p.ty - p.fy) * p.progress;
    const col = p.color || 'rgba(239,68,68,';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = `${col}${1 - p.progress})`;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = `${col}${0.25 * (1 - p.progress)})`;
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Draw device nodes with real-time state rings
  const typeColors = {router:'#3b82f6',firewall:'#8b5cf6',iot:'#10b981',it:'#06b6d4'};
  const typeIcons = {router:'🌐',firewall:'🛡️',iot:'📡',it:'💻'};

  for (const d of topoData.devices) {
    if (!shouldRenderDevice(d)) continue;
    const x = d.x * W, y = d.y * H;
    let baseColor = typeColors[d.type] || '#94a3b8';
    let ringRadius = 22;
    let ringColor = 'rgba(59,130,246,0.15)';
    let borderStroke = baseColor;
    let badgeIcon = typeIcons[d.type] || '•';

    // Real-Time Traffic States
    if (d.state === 'BLOCKED') {
      // Red Pulsing Ring
      const pulse = Math.sin(Date.now() / 150) * 5;
      ringRadius = 24 + pulse;
      ringColor = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.35)';
      borderStroke = '#ef4444';
      badgeIcon = '🚫';
    } else if (d.state === 'GRACE') {
      // Amber Warning Ring
      const pulse = Math.sin(Date.now() / 250) * 3;
      ringRadius = 23 + pulse;
      ringColor = 'rgba(245,158,11,0.25)';
      borderStroke = '#f59e0b';
      badgeIcon = '⚠️';
    } else {
      // Benign Green / Cyan Ring
      ringColor = baseColor.replace(')', ',0.12)').replace('rgb', 'rgba');
      borderStroke = baseColor;
    }

    // Outer Glow / Pulse Ring
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, ringRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = ringColor;
    ctx.fill();

    // Node Body
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = hoveredDevice === d ? 'rgba(30,41,59,0.95)' : 'rgba(10,14,26,0.92)';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = borderStroke;
    ctx.lineWidth = hoveredDevice === d ? 3.5 : 2;
    ctx.stroke();

    // Node Center Icon
    ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(badgeIcon, x, y);

    // Country Flag + Node Label
    const flag = d.flag || '🏠';
    ctx.font = '600 11px Inter, sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = d.state === 'BLOCKED' ? '#f87171' : d.state === 'GRACE' ? '#fbbf24' : '#cbd5e1';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(`${flag} ${d.label || d.id}`, x, y + 27);

    // IP Subtitle
    if (d.ip) {
      ctx.font = '400 9px monospace';
      ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
      ctx.fillText(d.ip, x, y + 39);
    }
  }

  // Draw Hover Tooltip
  if (hoveredDevice) {
    const hx = hoveredDevice.x * W, hy = hoveredDevice.y * H;
    const ttText = `${hoveredDevice.flag || ''} ${hoveredDevice.label || hoveredDevice.id} [${hoveredDevice.state || 'BENIGN'}] - Click to Manage`;
    ctx.font = '600 11px Inter, sans-serif';
    const textW = ctx.measureText(ttText).width;
    const pad = 8;
    const boxX = Math.max(10, Math.min(W - textW - pad*2 - 10, hx - (textW + pad*2)/2));
    const boxY = Math.max(10, hy - 48);

    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15,23,42,0.95)';
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56,189,248,0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(boxX, boxY, textW + pad*2, 24, 6);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(ttText, boxX + pad, boxY + 12);
  }

  topoAnimFrame = requestAnimationFrame(drawTopology);
}

// --- TOP ATTACKERS ---
async function loadTopAttackers() {
  try {
    const r = await fetch('/api/top_attackers');
    const j = await r.json();
    const el = document.getElementById('top_attackers');
    if (!j.ok || !j.attackers.length) { el.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;color:var(--text3);padding:20px;font-size:13px">No attack data yet</div>'; return; }
    const max = j.attackers[0].count || 1;
    el.innerHTML = j.attackers.map((a, i) =>
      `<div class="attacker-row">
        <div class="attacker-rank ${i<3?'top':''}">#${i+1}</div>
        <div class="attacker-flag">${a.flag||'🌐'}</div>
        <div class="attacker-ip">${a.ip}</div>
        <div class="attacker-bar-wrap"><div class="attacker-bar" style="width:${(a.count/max)*100}%"></div></div>
        <div class="attacker-count">${a.count}</div>
        ${a.blocked?'<span class="tag t-bad" style="font-size:10px">BLOCKED</span>':''}
      </div>`
    ).join('');
  } catch(e) {}
}

// --- DATA REFRESH ---
async function refreshCounts() {
  try {
    const r = await fetch('/api/counts?window_minutes=60');
    const j = await r.json();
    animateValue(document.getElementById('mt_total'), j.total ?? 0);
    animateValue(document.getElementById('mt_attacks'), j.attacks ?? 0);
    animateValue(document.getElementById('mt_blocks'), j.blocks ?? 0);
    // Detection rate
    const rate = j.total > 0 ? ((j.attacks / j.total) * 100).toFixed(1) + '%' : '-';
    document.getElementById('mt_rate').textContent = rate;
    // Update gauge based on recent attack ratio
    const attackRatio = j.total > 0 ? j.attacks / j.total : 0;
    updateGauge(attackRatio);
    // Update nav badge
    const badge = document.getElementById('nav_attack_count');
    if (j.attacks > 0) { badge.style.display = ''; badge.textContent = j.attacks; } else { badge.style.display = 'none'; }
    // Sparklines
    sparkHistory.total.push(j.total); sparkHistory.attacks.push(j.attacks); sparkHistory.blocks.push(j.blocks);
    if (sparkHistory.total.length > 20) { sparkHistory.total.shift(); sparkHistory.attacks.shift(); sparkHistory.blocks.shift(); }
    updateSpark('spark_total', sparkHistory.total, 'rgba(59,130,246,0.5)');
    updateSpark('spark_attacks', sparkHistory.attacks, 'rgba(239,68,68,0.5)');
    updateSpark('spark_blocks', sparkHistory.blocks, 'rgba(245,158,11,0.5)');
    // Pie chart
    if (j.class_counts) {
      const entries = Object.entries(j.class_counts).sort((a,b) => b[1]-a[1]);
      pieChart.data.labels = entries.map(e => e[0]);
      pieChart.data.datasets[0].data = entries.map(e => e[1]);
      pieChart.update('none');
    }
    // Chips
    const catChips = document.getElementById('category_chips');
    if (catChips && j.category_counts) {
      const entries = Object.entries(j.category_counts).sort((a,b) => b[1]-a[1]);
      catChips.innerHTML = entries.map(([n,c]) => `<span class="chip" style="background:rgba(239,68,68,0.14);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,0.35);color:#fca5a5;font-weight:600">⚡ ${n}: ${c}</span>`).join('') || '<span class="chip">No active threats</span>';
    }
    const chips = document.getElementById('class_chips');
    if (chips && j.class_counts) {
      const entries = Object.entries(j.class_counts).sort((a,b) => b[1]-a[1]);
      chips.innerHTML = entries.map(([n,c]) => `<span class="chip">${n}: ${c}</span>`).join('') || '<span class="chip">No class data</span>';
    }
    const blockChips = document.getElementById('block_chips');
    if (blockChips && j.block_breakdown) {
      const entries = Object.entries(j.block_breakdown).sort((a,b) => b[1]-a[1]);
      blockChips.innerHTML = entries.map(([n,c]) => `<span class="chip">${n}: ${c}</span>`).join('') || '<span class="chip">No blocks</span>';
    }
  } catch(e) {}
}

async function refreshEvents() {
  try {
    const q = lastTs ? ('?since_ts=' + encodeURIComponent(lastTs)) : '';
    const r = await fetch('/api/events' + q);
    const j = await r.json();
    const list = j.events || [];
    if (!list.length) return;
    allEvents = allEvents.concat(list);
    if (allEvents.length > 500) allEvents = allEvents.slice(-500);
    renderTable();
    // Chart update
    for (const e of list) {
      chartData.labels.push(iso(e.ts));
      chartData.scores.push(e.score ?? 0);
      chartData.thresholds.push(e.effective_threshold ?? null);
    }
    if (chartData.labels.length > 100) {
      chartData.labels.splice(0, chartData.labels.length - 100);
      chartData.scores.splice(0, chartData.scores.length - 100);
      chartData.thresholds.splice(0, chartData.thresholds.length - 100);
    }
    chart.data.labels = chartData.labels;
    chart.data.datasets[0].data = chartData.scores;
    chart.data.datasets[1].data = chartData.thresholds;
    chart.update('none');
    // Track latest block timestamp
    for (const e of list) {
      if (e.action && String(e.action).startsWith('BLOCK') && e.ts > lastBlockTs) {
        lastBlockTs = e.ts;
      }
    }
    lastTs = list[list.length - 1].ts;
  } catch(e) {}
}

// --- CONFIG ---
async function loadConfig() {
  try {
    const j = await (await fetch('/api/config')).json();
    const d = j.decision || {};
    document.getElementById('ctl_threshold').value = d.threshold ?? 0.65;
    document.getElementById('ctl_adaptive').checked = d.use_adaptive ?? false;
    document.getElementById('ctl_grace').value = d.grace ?? 3;
    document.getElementById('ctl_window').value = d.window ?? 5;
    document.getElementById('ctl_cool').value = d.cooldown_sec ?? 30;
    const b = document.getElementById('mode_badge');
    if (d.dry_run) { b.textContent = 'DEMO'; b.className = 'mode-badge demo'; }
    else { b.textContent = 'LIVE'; b.className = 'mode-badge live'; }
    document.getElementById('mi_thr').textContent = d.threshold ?? '-';
  } catch(e) {}
  // Model info
  try {
    const m = await (await fetch('/api/model')).json();
    if (m.model_type) document.getElementById('mi_type').textContent = m.model_type;
  } catch {}
  try {
    const h = await (await fetch('/health')).json();
    if (h.model) {
      if (h.model.version) document.getElementById('mi_ver').textContent = 'v' + h.model.version;
      if (h.model.roc_auc) document.getElementById('mi_auc').textContent = h.model.roc_auc;
      if (h.model.features_count) document.getElementById('mi_feat').textContent = h.model.features_count;
    }
  } catch {}
  try {
    const e = await (await fetch('/api/v1/ensemble')).json();
    if (e.ok) document.getElementById('mi_ens').textContent = e.strategy || '-';
  } catch { document.getElementById('mi_ens').textContent = 'off'; }
}

async function saveConfig() {
  const body = {decision:{
    threshold: parseFloat(document.getElementById('ctl_threshold').value),
    use_adaptive: document.getElementById('ctl_adaptive').checked,
    grace: parseInt(document.getElementById('ctl_grace').value),
    window: parseInt(document.getElementById('ctl_window').value),
    cooldown_sec: parseInt(document.getElementById('ctl_cool').value)
  }};
  const j = await (await fetch('/api/config',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(body)})).json();
  const msg = document.getElementById('save_msg');
  msg.textContent = j.ok ? '✅ Config saved — restart decision loop to apply' : 'Error: ' + (j.error||'');
  msg.style.color = j.ok ? 'var(--green)' : 'var(--red)';
  setTimeout(() => msg.textContent = '', 3500);
}

    const res = await fetch('/api/demo/status');

function updateDemoUI(isRunning) {
  const badge = document.getElementById('demo_status_badge');
  const btnStart = document.getElementById('btn_demo_start');
  const btnStop = document.getElementById('btn_demo_stop');
  if (isRunning) {
    if (badge) { badge.className = 'tag t-ok'; badge.textContent = '● STREAMING'; }
    if (btnStart) btnStart.style.display = 'none';
    if (btnStop) btnStop.style.display = 'inline-flex';
  } else {
    if (badge) { badge.className = 'tag t-warn'; badge.textContent = '○ STOPPED'; }
    if (btnStart) btnStart.style.display = 'inline-flex';
    if (btnStop) btnStop.style.display = 'none';
  }
}

async function launchAttack(type) {
  const el = document.getElementById('sim_msg');
  if (el) el.textContent = '⏳ Injecting ' + type.toUpperCase() + ' attack burst...';
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/demo/inject', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ type: type })
    });
    const j = await res.json();
    if (j.ok) {
      if (el) el.innerHTML = `✅ <strong>${j.attack_type.toUpperCase()}</strong> burst injected. Decision loop is scoring.`;
      showToast('attack', `⚡ Injected ${j.attack_type.toUpperCase()} attack burst`);
    } else {
      if (el) el.textContent = '❌ Error: ' + (j.error || 'Failed');
    }
    setTimeout(() => { if (el) el.textContent = ''; }, 5000);
  } catch(err) {
    if (el) el.textContent = '❌ Network error.';
    setTimeout(() => { if (el) el.textContent = ''; }, 4000);
  }
}

// --- CLOCK ---
function tickClock() {
  const t = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', {hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',second:'2-digit'});
  document.getElementById('clock').textContent = t;
  const fc = document.getElementById('footer_clock');
  if (fc) fc.textContent = new Date().toISOString().replace('T',' ').slice(0,19) + ' UTC';
}

// --- MAIN TICK ---
async function tick() {
  tickClock();
  await refreshCounts();
  await refreshEvents();
  await checkDemoStatus();
}
// Federated Learning & Drift Status Helpers (Phase 6)
async function loadFederatedStatus() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/v1/federated/status');
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const data = await res.json();
    if (!data.ok) return;

    const roundEl = document.getElementById('fed_round_num');
    const hashEl = document.getElementById('fed_model_hash');
    const nodeEl = document.getElementById('fed_node_count');
    const badgeEl = document.getElementById('fed_drift_badge');
    const psiEl = document.getElementById('fed_drift_psi');
    const recEl = document.getElementById('fed_recommendation');

    if (roundEl) roundEl.textContent = `Round ${data.round || 0}`;
    if (hashEl) hashEl.textContent = `hash: ${data.global_model_hash || '-'}`;
    if (nodeEl) nodeEl.textContent = `${data.total_nodes || 4} Active Nodes`;

    const drift = data.drift_status || {};
    if (badgeEl) {
      if (drift.drift_detected) {
        badgeEl.textContent = '🟡 Drift Detected';
        badgeEl.style.color = 'var(--amber)';
      } else {
        badgeEl.textContent = '🟢 Fleet Stable';
        badgeEl.style.color = 'var(--green)';
      }
    }
    if (psiEl) psiEl.textContent = `Mean PSI: ${(drift.mean_psi || 0).toFixed(4)}`;
    if (recEl) {
      recEl.textContent = drift.recommendation || 'FLEET_STABLE';
      recEl.style.color = drift.recommendation === 'TRIGGER_FEDERATED_SYNC' ? 'var(--amber)' : '#f8fafc';
    }
  } catch(e) {}
}

async function triggerFederatedRound() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn_fed_round');
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '⏳ Training...'; }
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/v1/federated/round', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ epochs: 3, lr: 0.02, reason: 'dashboard_operator' }),
    });
    const j = await res.json();
    if (j.ok) {
      showToast('info', `FedAvg Round ${j.round_report.round} complete! Hash: ${j.round_report.global_model_hash}`);
      loadFederatedStatus();
    } else {
      showToast('error', j.error || 'Federated round failed');
    }
  } catch(e) {
    showToast('error', 'Network error triggering federated round');
  } finally {
    if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = '🔄 Run FedAvg Round'; }
  }
}

// Enterprise Phase 11: SOC Metrics & MITRE Heatmap Poller
async function loadSocKpis() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/v1/soc/kpis');

    if (!data.ok) return;

    // MTTD

    if (mttdBadge) {
      if (data.mttd_sla_status === 'MET') {
        mttdBadge.textContent = 'SLA MET';
        mttdBadge.style.background = 'rgba(16,185,129,0.2)';
        mttdBadge.style.color = '#10b981';
      } else {
        mttdBadge.textContent = 'BREACHED';
        mttdBadge.style.background = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.2)';
        mttdBadge.style.color = '#ef4444';
      }
    }

    // MTTR
    const mttrEl = document.getElementById('soc_mttr_val');
    const mttrBadge = document.getElementById('soc_mttr_badge');
    if (mttrEl) mttrEl.textContent = `${(data.mttr_ms || 0).toFixed(1)} ms`;
    if (mttrBadge) {
      if (data.mttr_sla_status === 'MET') {
        mttrBadge.textContent = 'SLA MET';
        mttrBadge.style.background = 'rgba(16,185,129,0.2)';
        mttrBadge.style.color = '#10b981';
      } else {
        mttrBadge.textContent = 'BREACHED';
        mttrBadge.style.background = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.2)';
        mttrBadge.style.color = '#ef4444';
      }
    }

    // Audit Ledger
    const auditEl = document.getElementById('soc_audit_val');
    const auditBadge = document.getElementById('soc_audit_chain_badge');
    if (auditEl && auditBadge) {
      if (data.audit_chain_status === 'VERIFIED') {
        auditBadge.textContent = 'VERIFIED';
        auditBadge.style.background = 'rgba(16,185,129,0.2)';
        auditBadge.style.color = '#10b981';
        auditEl.style.color = '#10b981';
      } else {
        auditBadge.textContent = 'COMPROMISED';
        auditBadge.style.background = 'rgba(239,68,68,0.2)';
        auditBadge.style.color = '#ef4444';
        auditEl.style.color = '#ef4444';
      }
    }

    // Fleet Immunity
    const immVal = document.getElementById('soc_immunity_val');
    const immBadge = document.getElementById('soc_immunity_badge');
    if (immVal) {
      immVal.textContent = `${(data.fleet_immunity_index || 0).toFixed(1)}%`;
      immVal.style.color = data.fleet_immunity_rating === 'OPTIMAL' ? '#10b981' : (data.fleet_immunity_rating === 'STABLE' ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444');
    }
    if (immBadge) {
      immBadge.textContent = data.fleet_immunity_rating || 'OPTIMAL';
      const c = data.fleet_immunity_rating === 'OPTIMAL' ? '#10b981' : (data.fleet_immunity_rating === 'STABLE' ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444');
      immBadge.style.color = c;
      immBadge.style.background = `${c}33`;
    }

    // Hardware XDP Drops & Blocks
    const xdpVal = document.getElementById('soc_xdp_val');
    const blocksSub = document.getElementById('soc_blocks_sub');
    if (xdpVal) xdpVal.textContent = `${(data.xdp_hardware_drops || 0).toLocaleString()} pkts`;
    if (blocksSub) blocksSub.textContent = `Active blocks: ${data.active_blocks_count || 0}`;

    // MITRE ATT&CK Matrix
    const mitre = data.mitre_matrix || {};
    const totEl = document.getElementById('mitre_total_mapped');
    const actTacticsEl = document.getElementById('mitre_active_tactics');
    if (totEl) totEl.textContent = mitre.total_mapped_threats || 0;
    if (actTacticsEl) actTacticsEl.textContent = `${mitre.active_tactics_count || 0} / 6`;

    const tactics = (mitre && mitre.tactics) ? mitre.tactics : {};
    const tacticKeys = ['TA0043', 'TA0001', 'TA0002', 'TA0006', 'TA0011', 'TA0040'];
    tacticKeys.forEach(tid => {
      const t = tactics[tid] || { count: 0, techniques: [] };
      const colEl = document.getElementById(`mitre_col_${tid}`);
      const cntEl = document.getElementById(`mitre_cnt_${tid}`);
      const techEl = document.getElementById(`mitre_tech_${tid}`);

      if (cntEl) {
        cntEl.textContent = t.count || 0;
        if (t.count > 0) {
          cntEl.style.background = t.color || '#ef4444';
          cntEl.style.color = '#ffffff';
        } else {
          cntEl.style.background = '#1e293b';
          cntEl.style.color = '#94a3b8';
        }
      }

      if (colEl) {
        if (t.count > 0) {
          colEl.classList.add('mitre-col-active');
        } else {
          colEl.classList.remove('mitre-col-active');
        }
      }

      if (techEl) {
        if (t.techniques && t.techniques.length > 0) {
          techEl.innerHTML = t.techniques.slice(0, 3).map(tech => `<div style="margin-bottom:2px;font-weight:600;color:#e2e8f0">• ${tech}</div>`).join('');
        } else {
          techEl.textContent = 'No active threats';
        }
      }
    });

  } catch(e) {}
}
